purpose: Qualify exact reader precision semantics before consuming another legal development group, while exercising the actual native RuVector backend within the same bounded worker.

explicit_delta_from_parent.why: The original proposal prohibited other native calls. This new source-frozen addendum permits exactly one deterministic-vector RuVector index and three searches in the same 600-second qualification process. It does not select the six NLI premises.

native_trace.vectors: Literal lowercase token counts, with tokenizer and exact vectors frozen by worker source before measurement.
native_trace.database: fresh empty native RuVector cosine database; exact pinned package and binary
native_trace.input_premises: Exactly the three frozen engineering canary premises only
native_trace.query: Each unchanged canary hypothesis; three identical hypotheses retained as three explicit searches
native_trace.controls: Independent cosine ordering and lexical ordering recorded as engineering metadata; no model or gold selection.
native_trace.direct_NLI_premise_policy: Always each canary's own unchanged premise; never replace it with a retrieved premise.

role_limits.canary_semantics: Explicit engineering canary expected labels only, never benchmark generalization.

gates.parent_semantics_and_fidelity_gates: Unchanged: FP32 3/3, INT8 3/3, same labels, finite unmodified T1 softmax/mass<=1e-6, max per-class probability drift<=0.05.
gates.native_trace: Exact pinned actual native binary and package, exactly3 searches of3 literal premises, full ordering must match independent cosine reference; separate lexical metadata does not define expected semantic labels.
gates.process: One original model initialization, one quantization, exactly6 attempted/completed neural pair forwards, no BGE/ORT/previous-reader/native104/API/GPU calls; CPU2/interops1/600s including imports/load/state hashes/quantization/cleanup; no retries.
gates.failure_policy: Any frozen gate failure rejects engineering readiness; retain all outcomes and close all unspent epoch slots. No repair or additional forward in this epoch.

scope: Engineering-only. Neither passing canaries nor matching deterministic native rankings demonstrates legal competence, retrieval efficacy, benchmark generalization, official result or SOTA.
